content.title: Bryan Adams Announces 2026 US Tour with Pat Benatar & Neil Giraldo
content.text: Bryan Adams has announced a Summer 2026 US tour featuring support from Pat Benatar & Neil Giraldo. The outing will precede a previously announced Canadian jaunt set for the late summer. The US run marks the second leg of Adams’ “Roll with the Punches” tour, with the Canadian rocker having toured North America with Benatar & Giraldo last fall, as well. The newly announced leg kicks off July 24th in St. Louis, and runs through an August 16th show in Milwaukee, with stops in New Orleans, Orlando, Baltimore, Detroit, and other cities. Get Bryan Adams Tickets Here Adams is touring in support of his 2025 album, Roll with the Punches, his sixteenth studio LP overall. Last year, he played more than 80 shows as part of his “Roll with the Punches” tour. Beyond the Boys Club: Nita StraussOn April 18th, Bryan Adams will release the album Tough Town on vinyl for Record Store Day. The 10-song effort was previously only included as part of a super deluxe edition of Roll with the Punches. Meanwhile, Pat Benatar and her husband/musical partner Neil Giraldo were inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame in 2022. As mentioned, the US dates will be followed by a previously announced Canadian leg. See Bryan Adams’ full list of tour dates below, and look for tickets here.
